_about: Ethyl acetate (1) + Isobutanol (2): isobaric T-x-y at 101.0 kPa. Rows: liquid mole fraction of ethyl acetate, boiling temperature in K, vapour mole fraction of ethyl acetate, as stored in the ThermoML Archive record (mole fractions of the other component converted with x_1 = 1 - x_2).
